title: Hidden-ensemble leakage-aware robust GRAPE
difficulty_explanation: A nominal or mean-risk pulse is insufficient: the submitted qutrit pulse must suppress leakage and coherent error over secret coupled perturbations while obeying hard endpoint, amplitude, and slew constraints.
solution_explanation: The expert uses TensorCircuit QuditCircuit propagators and exact JAX reverse-mode gradients, a composite-pulse warm start, deterministic uncertainty-set augmentation, and a continuation from mean loss to a smooth worst-case loss.
verification_explanation: An independent SciPy matrix-exponential oracle evaluates the pulse on hidden seeded interior members and every uncertainty-box corner, then enforces fidelity, leakage, and hardware constraints.
conditioning_notes: The projected computational-block fidelity is global-phase invariant. Leakage is evaluated independently because a good nominal trace overlap can hide population outside the computational subspace. Sparse axis anchors do not control coupled box corners.
api_risks: Requires differentiable tensorcircuit.QuditCircuit.unitary, QuditCircuit.matrix, tc.gates.Gate, and the JAX backend expm in the pinned TensorCircuit-NG image. The expert fixes complex128 to avoid threshold-scale drift.

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The base seed generates public uncertainty widths and pulse parameters; base_seed XOR 0x5A17C3 initializes the independent 48-point held-out interior stream, while all eight corners are enumerated.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: The exact public control config is deterministic under the pinned runtime and is identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest; hidden held-out members and oracle metrics are excluded.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and ndarray/scalar normalization over the exact public config; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6 and SciPy 1.17.1; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.
